question: What is the meaning of building certification in relation to health and safety aspects?
description: Building certification assesses the quality of a building, including health and safety aspects. It serves as an objective third-party verification, allowing comparisons between buildings. Certification also acts as a marketing tool, highlighting the building's compliance with health and safety standards.
